activities.activity_description: Set up the build system, directory structure, and basic configurations (e.g., Maven/Gradle, Spring dependencies) for the Spring Cloud Stream modules in the s-c-s repository.
Extract the mqtt module from Spring XD, adapt its code to function as a sink in Spring Cloud Stream, and perform unit testing to ensure basic functionality.
Extract the shell module from Spring XD, adapt it as a sink for Spring Cloud Stream, and verify its operation with unit tests.
Extract the splunk module from Spring XD, adapt it as a sink for Spring Cloud Stream, and conduct unit testing to validate the migration.
Extract the tcp module from Spring XD, adapt it as a sink for Spring Cloud Stream, and ensure it works correctly through unit tests.
Extract the jdbc module from Spring XD, adapt it to function as a source in Spring Cloud Stream, and perform unit testing to confirm its functionality as a data source.
Port the aggregator module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, redesigning it as a processor module, and implement unit tests to verify aggregation logic.
Port the http-client module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream, adapting it as a processor module, and conduct unit tests to ensure HTTP client operations work as expected.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all migrated modules in a simulated streaming pipeline scenario to ensure compatibility and correctness.
